text_block_list.text:
One day, while out and about with Agnes 
Tachyon...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Give up and drink my new beverage already. 
I promise a brand-new experience awaits 
you.
choice_data_list:
Ah, there's an interesting crane game over 
there!

Ah, there's a fun-looking crane game over 
there!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trying to dodge the topic like that—oh, 
well isn't this convenient?

Agnes Tachyon's eyes gleam with a dull 
light as she gazes at the crane game.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What do you need to snag a prize from a 
crane game?! Instantaneous, split-second 
focus!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"This drink is lavishly packed with 
ingredients that stimulate the A10 nerve 
group and self-reward neural circuits to 
drastically enhance focus, you see."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
In other words, if you drink this, you can 
grab all the prizes you want! Come on, 
don't be shy, bottoms up! Chug, chug, 
chug!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
You really are a high-maintenance guinea 
pig! Ah, and if the results aren't 
promising, you'll be drinking a different 
potion, so be prepared for that!
—I can't afford to lose this game!!
